documentation.note: Server graph nodes are called as f.<name>(...) inside an event handler; events are listened to with .on(name, handler). scope "raw" searches every bundled definition file instead (client graphs, enums).

results.name: queryIfAchievementIsCompleted
results.summary: Searches whether the Achievement corresponding to a specific ID on the Target Entity is complete
results.zh: 查询成就是否完成: 查询目标实体上特定序号对应的成就是否完成 是否完成

results.name: setAchievementProgressTally
results.signature: setAchievementProgressTally(setEntity: EntityValue, achievementId: IntValue, progressTally: IntValue): void;
results.summary: Set the progress counter for the specified Achievement ID on the Target Entity
results.zh: 设置成就进度计数: 设置指定实体上对应成就序号的成就进度计数

params.name: progressTally
params.en: Sets the Progress Count to the input value
params.zh: 进度计数: 修改后的进度计数为输入的值

results.name: changeAchievementProgressTally
results.signature: changeAchievementProgressTally(changeEntity: EntityValue, achievementId: IntValue, progressTallyChangeValue: IntValue): void;
results.summary: Change the progress counter for the specified Achievement ID on the Target Entity
results.zh: 变更成就进度计数: 变更指定实体上对应成就序号的成就进度计数

params.name: progressTallyChangeValue
params.en: New Value = Previous Value + Change Value Progress Tally Increase Value
params.zh: 进度计数变更值: 变更后值=变更前值+变更值
